question: What rate would I get on a 500k loan with a 20% deposit?
reply:
A 20% deposit means an LVR of 80%, which falls in the "LVR 60.01% to 80%" band on the Example Lender page (read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time).

That band shows:
Interest rate: 6.14% p.a.
Comparison rate: 6.17% p.a.
Monthly fee: $0

Note: this is a lookup from the lender's page, not a loan assessment — whether this product or lender suits a specific deal is a separate call. Also, this rate may have changed since the page was read; check the live page for the current figure.
